ground_constraints_size.description: Compiled-task succinctness and exact plan preservation on large generated tasks (24-32 objects, schemas of arity up to 5, conditional and universally quantified effects) with 2-6 ground trajectory constraints; counterpart of the paper's Ground dataset.
ground_constraints_size.notes: Paper values are Table 3 averages over the IPC-2023 benchmark, where the TCORE comparator grounds by reachability (about 21K actions). The gym's comparator is the full grounding of each generated task (about 10^6-10^8 actions), so gym log-ratios are 3-4 orders of magnitude more negative; the paper's raw numbers and the log-ratios derived from them are kept unchanged under _paper_reported as context, not targets. results hold the paper's correctness claim (semantic_agreement 1.0) and, for the size metrics, the gym's own reference run on the public train slice. Held-out tasks are generated by eval/test/ at test time; full grounding is millions of actions, so ground-first compilation does not fit the per-task limits.

semantic_agreement.description: Fraction of evaluator checks on which the compiled task accepts exactly the plans the constrained task accepts (hidden goal-reaching probes on large tasks; complete product-automaton exploration on small tasks). Any disagreement fails the whole run, which then gets the worst value of every metric.

effects_vs_ground_log10.description: Mean over tasks of log10(compiled conditional effects / conditional effects of the fully grounded task). The paper's succinctness claim (Table 3, effects). Worst value 1.0.

actions_vs_ground_log10.description: Mean over tasks of log10(compiled actions / ground actions of the fully grounded task). Paper Table 3, actions. Worst value 1.0.

formula_nodes_log10.description: Mean over tasks of log10(total formula nodes in all preconditions, effect conditions and the goal, plus one per initial-state atom added or removed). Size of the compiled specification beyond its effect count. Worst value 7.0.

max_formula_nodes_log10.description: Mean over tasks of log10(nodes of the largest single precondition, effect condition or goal). The paper reports the largest introduced formula (Section 6.1). Worst value 7.0.

many_constraints_size.description: Large generated tasks with 30-45 trajectory constraints (mixed ground and quantified). The paper's own limitation (Section 6.1, Appendix D): lifted compilers add monitoring for every constraint to every action that may affect it, so the compiled specification grows with the number of constraints.
many_constraints_size.notes: The paper reports no number for this experiment. results hold the paper's correctness claim (semantic_agreement 1.0, Propositions 1 and 3) and, for the size metrics, the gym's own reference run on the public train slice (scoring/scores_train.json), not a paper value. The ground-first baseline is listed with the paper's correctness claim only; in the gym it cannot compile the large tasks and its run is scored as failed. Added in the hardening iteration as the experiment where the paper's method falls short.

constraint_type_suite.description: Small generated tasks (3-4 objects) with 1-3 constraints covering all five families, ground and quantified. The compiled task is checked by complete exploration of its product with the original task and its constraint monitors (every reachable state pair; tasks with more than 2500 reachable states are not generated).
